review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the university’s network infrastructure to ensure secure, stable, and high-performance connectivity across campuses and remote environments. The role involves collaborating with IT staff and academic departments to support network-related projects, implementing network security policies, and maintaining documentation of network topology, configurations, and procedures. Qualifications Candidates
eligibility_evidence: This is a full-time hybrid role based in Cairo, Egypt, with a combination of on-site work at Damietta University facilities and some work-from-home flexibility.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Network Engineering and Network Design, including experience with LAN/WAN architecture, wireless networks, and network capacity planning.
